items.item: FOR-REN-opening.md: (d2a′) said more than the Lean (medium) — FIXED
items.how: The recommended body option said 'whatever whole worth it puts on what it leaves at the end, at its optimum holds ... and breaks at once whatever needs more'. At a worth above what is drawn, Optimum.frontier_holds_valued and Web.frontier_rebuilt_valued take `bounded` (no open course leaves more than y with r); OpenCourse lets a course draw nothing, so the premise is not implied by the others, and without it nothing is shown. The sentence now adds '(above the worth of what it draws, where no course can leave more than that level regrown once)' (Chinese: （若高于所取用者的价值，则须没有哪条进程能留下多于那一水平再更新一次之量）); 'In short' says the same; 'the proofs show it does not' became 'under the premises the proofs take it does not'.
